formal_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Fin m → Submodule ℂ (Fin m → ℂ)), 2 ≤ m → (∀ i : Fin m, (fun j : Fin m => if (i : ℕ) = 0 ∧ (j : ℕ) = 0 then (1 : ℂ) - (m : ℂ) else 1) ∈ U i) → (∀ x : Fin m × Fin m → ℂ, (∀ i : Fin m, (fun j : Fin m => x (i, j)) ∈ U i) → MvPolynomial.eval x (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) = 0) → ∑ i : Fin m, Module.finrank ℂ (U i) ≤ 2 * m - 2
plain_statement: Let m >= 2 and U_1..U_m be subspaces of C^m. If row i of Sigma_m (all ones, corner entry 1 - m) lies in U_i for every i, and perm_m vanishes on every matrix whose row i lies in U_i, then dim U_1 + ... + dim U_m <= 2m - 2. A restricted case of L-gct-037 at Sigma_m (spaces that are products of row spaces), tight. Paper proof of this seat's leg: the condition says the spaces V_i = U_i meet {first coordinate 0} are independent for the trace on C^(m-1), then a chain of Kneser steps (L-gct-065). Notes: lean/PEqualNP/Gct/Zeros037/theory/REPORT.md, Theorem 5.
title: Product-type linear spaces through Sigma_m inside the permanent hypersurface have dimension at most 2m - 2
